issues.issue: Did the officer wrongly refuse to weigh the Al Aqsa death call as hardship under s. 25(1), treating it as risk?
issues.applicant_position: Officer wrongly treated the Al Aqsa death call as risk to life under s. 97, not hardship; the evidence must be weighed.
issues.result_quote: That denunciation cannot be ignored; it must be viewed together with all other relevant matters
